file_stem: RWB E1 025 Document types and fields agreed
title: Document types and fields agreed
goal: One versioned list of 6 document types and 26 fields for OCR, classification and extraction
why: Every document step needs the same answer to 'what types exist and what fields matter'. Changing the list is a data load, not a release.
triggers: RW-COE prepares; Legal + Head of NPA sign
ace_note: No ACE read. Document types are Workbench reference data.

reads.note: LOV-RETENTION classes (via the P4 list service)

stores: Load file DOCTYPE-2026.11 with the Legal and NPA sign-off dates; 5-minute catalog cache

functions.name: DocumentTypeCatalog
functions.does: version in force, type by code

rules: BR1: Legal and NPA sign before extraction is built
BR3: one invalid row refuses the whole load
BR4: a version takes effect on valid_from; work already done keeps its version
risks: Missing Legal or NPA sign-off -> load refused (MSG-P3-027)
example: COURT_NOTICE: court_name, black_case_no, notice_date, hearing_date | LEGAL10Y | write_once true
